verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents an image-to-video model (`heygen-video-1` on POST /v3/models/videos) that turns an image into 5–30 s clips. Setting `aspect_ratio: "auto"` matches the source image's framing, and Photo Avatars animate a single still image of a person. Together these cover animating a still into motion. However, preservation of the subject and composition is only implied (aspect-ratio matching, face animation) rather than explicitly documented, and there is no hands-on or independent confirmation of image-to-video quality. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of subject/composition fidelity in image-to-video, camera/motion controls for image inputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
